title: Broader captured Sine99 pitch-pattern audit
status: Completed measurement-only test; both global pattern tests unevaluable under frozen gates, not evidence that hardware has no pitch grid.
outcome: The known long67/75 captured interval feature is not generalized into a pitch table. None of8new G/Dsharp contrasts has the required control+codec-qualified spectral/phase families. Two repeated non-octave intervals remain one-estimator conditional constraints; apparent octave observations also lack the required family coverage.

frozen_protocol.status: Frozen before extracting any new pitch-pattern frequencies; shared audio and known19notes are not a fresh hardware holdout.
frozen_protocol.selection: All source notes from program99 start with onset>=program+0.6s, gate>=0.20s, fixed interior onset+0.10 to off-0.06 at least0.05s. Deduplicate exact target windows; measure every selected note whose protected held interval covers each entire window. All metadata exclusions and all estimates retained.

calibration.method: Median of negative of two already measured original67/75 phase12 Opus-mid intervals. No new pitch frequencies enter this fixed two-class contrast. No other note-class lookup is fitted.

estimators.hann: Hann sym=False spectral energy, >=16x zero padding, nominal±75c peak search, bounded refinement nearestFFT±2bins, xatol1e-9. Use exact protected shared window.
estimators.phase6: Hann spectral center,±0.5s actual context, fixed fourth-order zero-phase6Hz complex demodulation,1kHz unwrapped-phase sampling, amplitude-squared weighted slope, ignoreamplitude<.2median; minimum16 phase samples.
estimators.joint120: Fixed120ms Hann joint local sin/cos+DC at every distinct program99 MIDI frequency, nominal equal-temperament centers. Precompute weighted pseudoinverse; evaluate at nearest sample to sharedwindow start and then96frame hops. Convert cos−i*sin coefficient to nominal-demodulated complexphase at each center. Amplitude-squared weighted unwrapped phase slope with<.2median veto. No basis frequency fit, no harmonic split, no window search; fit coefficient phase only.

frozen_protocol.control_waveforms: Stationary controls are continuous across each window plus0.6s context. Fixed phase2*pi*((midi*.6180339887498949)mod1). Gated ensemble sums all56program99 events, instant gate and rectangular off, phase resetper event2*pi*((event_index*.6180339887498949)mod1), no release/effects/noise. This is a leakage/phase-history null, not a hardware-envelope model. Nativeb11 mid is a separate composition/effect control.

eligibility.per_pair_estimator: Same sharedwindow: valid search/phase and abs(intervalerror)<=.10c for each of4 analytic controls and nativeb11 MID. Eligibility depends only on controls. Invalid estimates/failures remain. All data channels are reported but accepted capture tests use MID.
eligibility.captured_codec_agreement: An otherwise control-eligible pair/estimator must have abs(AAC−Opus intervalerror)<=.05c; otherwise report codec disagreement and do not use for pattern support.
eligibility.release_clear_diagnostic: Independently flag bothcomponents previous same-pitch off at least2.0s before sharedwindow start. Do not erase flagged mixed-history rows. Lowerharmonic neighbors within5c of integer2..8, held oroff within2s, are flagged and cannot be uniquely split into voices.
eligibility.G_Dsharp_window_support: Only primary_G_Dsharp_extension anchorwindows. Orient each interval as cG−cDsharp. A window supports the fixed contrast if at least2 control+codec-qualified estimator families including Hann and at leastonephase/joint are present, and every qualified estimator in both encodes has positive contrast>.20c and abs(contrast−fixedcalibration)<=.15c. No averaging away a qualified failure.
eligibility.G_Dsharp_overall_support: Require at least3 nonoverlapping primary anchorwindows collectivelyincluding>=2 new MIDI pitches, and no evaluated primaryanchorwindow with enough eligible families fails the fixed contrast. Otherwise report partial/inconsistent/inadequate evidence. Report release-clear subset separately; never equate apparent contrast with siliconproof.
eligibility.octave_support: For each primaryoctave anchorwindow, require same qualified-family count and all qualified AAC/Opus apparent octaveerrors abs<=.15c. Overall apparentoctave replication requires>=3pitchclasses and>=3nonoverlappinganchorwindows with no eligiblewindow failure. Harmonic ambiguity prevents identifying upperfundamental from a lowerharmonic even if this apparent replication passes.
eligibility.repeated_interval_diagnostic: For each exact MIDI pair with>=2 nonoverlapping anchorwindows and>=1 new event, retain everyeligiblemiderror and report fullrange, byestimator andcodec. Range<=.20c is the fixed descriptive consistency threshold; no classlookup is fitted.

frozen_protocol.no_independent_sample_confidence_claim: Nested windows, simultaneousvoices, reusedupload and encodes are correlated. All previously measured19events stay marked as calibration/reused, never freshholdout.

validation_receipt.validation_kind: Independent arithmetic/metadata/provenance, plus exact portable-tool frequency reproduction; not an independently implemented signal estimator
validation_receipt.first_validation_attempt: An overly strict bit-identity assertion found7 minimum-amplitude diagnostic roundoff differences, at most2.91e-15dB. All frequencies/cents/pairs/decisions are bit-identical; final validation discloses these diagnostics with1e-12dB tolerance.
validation_receipt.first_attempt_failure: The original extraction reached all rows but JSON rejected absent codec differences serialized as NaN. Preserved first script/log; changed only absent difference to null/false, reran unchanged protocol.
